title: AWS Lambda to Amazon SQS
description: Create a Lambda function that publishes to an SQS queue

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a SQS Queue and a Lambda function that once triggered will send a message to the Sqs Queue. The CDK application contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application.
